attempts.text:
I planned this by comparing, for each group, the cost of the driving needed to rescue them against the penalty for deferring them.

**Roads I did not use:** Dhunche market to Nilkantha village (floodwater, a truck was swept off it). Nilkantha village is also a dead end that doesn't help any pickup. Kakani school is not a valid drop-off point.

**Rescued:**
- **Four injured at Dhunche market:** car1 makes a 46-minute round trip. Deferring them would cost 320.
- **Three elderly at Myagang care home and one shopkeeper at Dhunche market:** car2 drives Thakre shelter → Myagang care home → Dhunche market → Thakre shelter, 64 minutes. Deferring them would cost 170.

**Deferred:**
- **Seven shopkeepers at Tadi market:** each group of four needs a 98-minute round trip to save 80 in penalties, so deferring is cheaper (140).
- **Young boy at Shivapuri village:** an 88-minute round trip to save a 60 penalty, so deferring is cheaper.
- **One shopkeeper at Dhunche market:** a separate 46-minute trip to save a 20 penalty is not worth it.

Total: 46 + 64 driving, plus 140 + 60 + 20 deferred, gives 330.

<plan>
drive car1 thakre-shelter dhunche-market
load car1 injured 4
drive car1 dhunche-market thakre-shelter
unload car1 injured 4
drive car2 thakre-shelter myagang-care-home
load car2 elderly 3
drive car2 myagang-care-home dhunche-market
load car2 adult 1
drive car2 dhunche-market thakre-shelter
unload car2 elderly 3
unload car2 adult 1
defer dhunche-market adult 1
defer tadi-market adult 7
defer shivapuri-village child 1
</plan>

COST: 330
